about.heading: About
about.summary: Computer Engineering student specializing in IoT and Embedded Systems at the Faculty of Sciences of Tunis. Freelance developer with hands-on experience in AI workflows, full-stack web development, cloud infrastructure, and embedded systems.

nextStepIT.description: Graduation project intern at NEXT STEP IT. Built vMigrate — an intelligent VM migration prediction system using XGBoost and SHAP for explainability, deployed on OpenShift with KubeVirt, with a React + FastAPI interface.

upwork.description: Freelance full-stack developer on Upwork. Delivered client projects using React, Vite, TanStack, Tailwind CSS, Flask, Django, and PHP.

triWeb.description: Summer internship at TriWeb (Charguia 2). Gained hands-on experience in a professional development environment.

ieee.description: Served as Chairperson of the IEEE MTTS Chapter at ESPRIT Student Branch, leading technical events and workshops.

gdsc.description: Marketing Manager and active member at GDSC FSS and GDSC FST, promoting developer community events.

volunteer.description: Community volunteer with Alert International, JCI, Youth Club, and Spark Engineer ENIS.

fst.description: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering with a specialization in IoT and Embedded Systems.

portfolio-app.description: Personal portfolio website built with Next.js, TypeScript, GSAP, and Framer Motion. Single-page, bilingual (EN/FR), and fully responsive.

sentinel-ai.description: AI-powered triage engine written in Go. Automatically classifies and prioritizes low-quality content for review pipelines.

templatr.description: Python tool for generating print-ready document templates at scale. Supports batch processing and customizable layouts.

bookhaven.description: Full-stack web application for book discovery and management, built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

phishguard.description: Browser-based phishing detection and awareness tool. Helps users identify and avoid malicious links.

pfa-attendees.description: ESP32-based IoT attendance system for academic events. Uses embedded hardware, sensors, and real-time data logging.

smart-street-lighting.description: Intelligent street lighting system using ESP32 and MQTT. Lights adjust based on ambient conditions and motion detection.

ieee-badge-writer.description: C#/.NET tool for writing and managing IEEE event badges. Forked and contributed to the ESPRIT IEEE Student Branch.

vmigrate.description: Intelligent VM migration prediction system using XGBoost and SHAP for explainability. Deployed on OpenShift with KubeVirt and a React + FastAPI interface.

math-genius.description: Full-stack math learning platform built with React, Vite, TanStack, Tailwind CSS, and Flask. Delivered as a freelance project.
